summary: The php port passes. I followed the version 3.3 guide and touched only php's own files. Final reviewed run (REGEN=1, after a fresh build, with my hand records) printed PORTCHECK php: PASS and exited 0, with 0 OPEN, 0 defect and 0 STALE. Its 5 contradictions all sit in the unported php README. The SCRATCH=1 run exits 1, as designed for a newly ported language. Guard ^php: 4/4 (forms, facts against runtime, account, negative controls). Suite without toolchain lanes: 2635 tests, 2630 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped. The php README example lane passes the same on OLD and NEW in all three models (default, crud, basic-server: 4 tests, 19 assertions, 0 failures; root README 4/4, README 20/20 or 18/18, REFERENCE 21/21 or 14/14 executed). I also ran the root quick start from the repository root of each generated SDK: OLD fails at `require_once 'demo_sdk.php'` (Failed opening required) in all three; NEW (`require_once 'php/demo_sdk.php'`) gets past the require and stops only at the live request. No interface change was needed, breaking or additive, and no defect class was recorded. I found three small gaps or losses and describe them under interface_gaps. Lines: 734 old component lines deleted (224 Quick + 420 Ref + 90 TopQuick); added 168 provider, 26 hook, +40 forms, +7 utility_php, +2/-1 Main_php.

interface_gaps.construct: Entity class name: the description computes it with entityClassName(e, coll) (no case folding, ts/src/helpers/sdkdesc.ts:272). The php runtime names its classes with entityClassName(entity, entityCollection(model), true), case-folded because PHP class names are case-insensitive (MainEntity_php.ts:20, Entity_php.ts:27, EntityOperation_php.ts:33).
interface_gaps.smallest_change: an optional className in DescSymbols, from the naming hook, used over the shared derivation where present (or a fold flag on the description)
interface_gaps.providers_forced: php only (no other component passes fold=true; grep over src/cmp/*/). No variation of the 21 shows a divergence: guardModelNames already renames case-folded collisions, so this is latent, not observed

interface_gaps.construct: OLD wrote entity getter return types in the heading (`data_get(): array`, `match_get(): array`). The runtime declares none (Entity.fragment.php:111,131), so the true signature has none. ReadmeRef.ts prints Member.returns only for client members (clientMember, ReadmeRef.ts:236), never for entity members, so the cited returns:'array' on data_get and match_get is declared but not printed
interface_gaps.smallest_change: print **Returns:** for an entity member that declares returns, as for a client member
interface_gaps.providers_forced: none (optional field; providers that declare entity returns would gain a line)
interface_gaps.worked_around: no; recorded as correction:signature-from-runtime, and the record type is still stated in the tutorial ('(an `array`)')

interface_gaps.construct: The `ref.facts.ctor[0]` citation of the line `require_once __DIR__ . '/demo_sdk.php';` cannot quote the file name. After extracting phpSdkFile into utility_php.ts, the only runtime-file quote is Main_php.ts `File({ name: phpSdkFile(model) }, ...)`. The guard rejects utility_php.ts as 'not one of the php runtime's files', yet it accepted the citation without the token demo_sdk/_sdk.php in any quote
interface_gaps.smallest_change: count the language's utility_<lang>.ts as a runtime file for citations, or have the guard require the filled {module} token in some quote
interface_gaps.providers_forced: rb and lua have the same shape (rbSdkFile, luaSdkModule)
